sections.title: Sound of elly
paragraphs: The letter name is (elly) /ɛj/. This letter makes one sound. You hear it in the word (lyuk) /ˈjuk/, which means hole. It is a voiced sound, so your throat shakes when you say it. The sound acts as a consonant, a sound made when the mouth narrows the air.

sections.title: How to say elly
paragraphs: Raise the middle of your tongue close to the roof of your mouth. Keep the tongue tip low behind your bottom teeth. Spread your lips slightly. Push air smoothly over the middle of your tongue with your voice on. Touch your throat with your hand to feel it shake.

sections.title: Spelling of elly
paragraphs: This letter always makes the same sound in standard speech. It sounds like the consonant in (lyuk) /ˈjuk/ at the start of a word. You also hear the same sound in the middle of a word, such as in (gólya) /ˈɡoːjɒ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with elly
paragraphs: Do not try to say an l sound before this letter. It never sounds like the l in light. Say it simply like the y in yes. Touch your tongue tip behind your bottom teeth so it does not touch the roof of your mouth.
